senses.definition: A costume, disguise to masquerade as something or someone else.
senses.example: And yet here he was, if one could credit one's senses, about to take part in a fancy-dress ball, a form of entertainment notoriously a testing experience for the toughest. And he was attending that fancy-dress ball, mark you--not, like every other well-bred Englishman, as a Pierrot, but as Mephistopheles--this involving, as I need scarcely stress, not only scarlet tights but a pretty frightful false beard.

senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see fancy, dress.
